final_claim: For the nondegenerate real six-parameter 3D quadratic map F=(a1*x+a2*y+a3*y^2,b1-b2*z,c*x), a unique primitive two-cycle exists iff a scalar discriminant Delta>0; its monodromy spectrum depends only on (A=a1,Delta); exact three-inequality Schur/Jury sink test and sharp existence for freely varying other coefficients iff -3/2<A<eta (eta root of A^4-8A^2-8A+4 in (0,1)).
limitations: Requires nonzero a3*b2*c and no positivity assumptions; excludes degenerate affine cases.
Sharp A window is existence over other five coefficients, not stability for every choice.
No higher-period, basin or chaotic-attractor conclusions.
